reopening_requirements.requirement: Admit an immutable exact source deposit, or a separately governed successor source revision, containing the canonical DEPTH producer and all missing order/normalization artifacts; bind repository, commit, tree, path, and blob identities.

The producer must deterministically emit exactly 448 ordered variables, the N=600 fitting rows, all 68 raw DEPTH rows, and the locked normalization/RHS conventions without reliance on unstable container, set, hash, or dictionary ordering.

Emit and digest the variable-order, fitting-row-order, raw-DEPTH-row-order, normalization, fitting-matrix, DEPTH-matrix, joint-matrix, and augmented-matrix artifacts; an independent process must reproduce the same identities.
Produce an exact rational consistency witness and an independent exact-Q rank certificate establishing fitting rank 313, joint rank 324, augmented rank 324, and solution dimension 448-324=124.

Provide exact modular pivot transcripts for q=33554393 and q=33554467 and replay them against the canonical matrices; modular agreement may corroborate but may not substitute for the rational certificate.

Use an independent checker that does not invoke the producer's rank or solver implementation and that fails closed on row/column reorder, normalization drift, stale digests, rank drift, inconsistent augmentation, false modular-to-rational lifting, and malformed witnesses.

Add the producer/verifier separation tests, required mutation suite, closed-schema validation, governed replay registration, and exact-head CI; then obtain the issue-required independent non-author review and exact-head authorization before protected merge.
